display.$description: Headings and marketing display. Printed-book seriousness that reads credible to a coach and aspirational to a 12-year-old.

mono.$description: Moves, clocks, coordinates, evaluations. Tabular by nature.

text.$description: Font sizes in rem so 200% zoom and user font-size preferences scale everything (WCAG 1.4.4). Layouts must also tolerate ~40% label expansion for de/fr.

5xl.$description: Statement scale for the landing hero and section openers.

6xl.$description: Bulletin scale: oversized display statements at wide breakpoints.

leading.$description: Unitless line-heights; body stays ≥1.5 to survive WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing overrides.
